thread:
matt_sales: Heads-up: customer 'NebulaSys' wants to POC a finetuned 13B model next week. Need a quick catalog-fit + SOW estimate.

rachel_engineer: which artifact? any custom tokenizer or ops?

matt_sales: they supplied `nebula-13b-v1` with custom bytepair vocab and a python postproc (non-CUDA). traffic ~8 qps peak.

jordan_sre: 8 qps for 13B should be fine on dedicated A100-80GB with autoscale. If python postproc is external, we can route postproc outside runtime with minimal impact.

alex_infra: No native CUDA ops is great. Tokenizer mapping required; conversion usually 1 engineer-day.

liz_solutions: Security questionnaire: they want customer-managed KMS and per-route RBAC. Private deployment optional. They also requested SOC2 evidence.

rachel_engineer: adapter plan: vocab map -> Redwood token format, validation suite, and perf smoke. Estimate 1-2 eng-days.

matt_sales: cost estimate so I can put in quote?

jordan_sre: one-off eng 2-4 days. Infra provisioning ~2 days. Monthly Dedicated estimate ~$9k-$12k. Private w/KMS extra ~$4k/mo.

liz_solutions: I'll prepare compliance packet and SOW addendum. If they only need customer KMS (no HSM) timeline is shorter.

matt_sales: action items: @rachel_engineer create adapter checklist. @alex_infra provide exact GPU SKU and runbook. @liz_solutions start SOC2 handoff.

ops-bot: ticket #NEB-POC-211 created.

rachel_engineer: test harness snippet to include in ticket:
```
MODEL=nebula-13b-v1
SEQ=512
BATCH=2
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"'$MODEL'","input":"sample"}'
```

matt_sales: thanks, I'll loop the customer in and confirm KMS/HSM.
